title: Bring chiral fibre at $q = \tfrac{1}{2}$: real segment with well-separated sheets
html:
Figure (Bring chiral fibre along a real segment, intermediate regime).

Companion to fig:bring-fibre-q0. Two-panel illustration of the chiral fibre structure away from any branch point in the intermediate q = \tfrac{1}{2} regime, where all three sheets remain well-separated.

The cubic and base match fig:bring-fibre-q0. We evaluate along the real segment z \in [-0.5, 1.5]. This segment lies outside any neighbourhood of the six branch points z \approx (0.119, \pm 1.054), (0.106, \pm 0.937), (-0.975, \pm 0.223). The cubic has one real root X_{\text{real}} and a complex-conjugate pair X_{\text{conj},1}, X_{\text{conj},2} = \overline{X_{\text{conj},1}}.

The right-hand stacked sub-plots show Re(X) (top) and Im(X) (bottom) versus z along the segment. The real sheet (solid) appears in Re-only with Im \equiv 0. The conjugate pair (dashed and dotted) have opposite imaginary parts and matching real parts.
